status: Prepared source-only; root independent review and execution required
scope: Saved ordinary/sparse Llama artifacts only. Three event targets; no models or product imports. This script does not change strict sparse observer or results.
association_contract: Enumerate every saved event bearing one of the three exact target keys, their three mechanism scopes, or stale decoder.attention.num_heads/num_kv_heads targets. Record nondeciding rows separately; do not silently filter bad decisions.

Every consumed/absent_default decision must name an admitted exact target, original expected reader, matching mechanism, exact root document/path/fingerprint, and final canonical value/status hash. Native final hash must agree with saved ledger presentation reference.

Mechanism/geometry expected operand paths come from the saved original-proof operand derivation. Each exact operand must have exactly one decision event; duplicates, missing paths, stale targets, extra paths and wrong hashes fail even when identical across conditions.

Activation expected path is explicitly hidden_act for this bounded witness; its scalar must equal the saved native activation value via checkpoint or class overlay. This is a value-channel association predicate, never an activation-application proof.

Checkpoint events require present/consumed/checkpoint_declared/value. Omitted-default events require absent/absent_default/class_default/missing with exact default path, matching overlay value, and no checkpoint occurrence.
Report semantic proof presence separately for every fact. Missing activation proof does not make correct association fail and never becomes qualified because association passes.
The original sparse bracket must have pins_equal=true. All audit input files are hashed before/after. Original sparse FAIL remains visible and untouched.
reviewed_source_basis: Frozen26 actual artifact formats read without executing audit; original-proof-operands records include source_path/source_kind/checkpoint_path/value.

receipts.value_status_hash reimplemented exactly for JSON-shaped saved values (16 hex chars); config_access.checkpoint_fingerprint reimplemented for saved JSON domain. No deserialized receipt is treated as live proof.
Function body and AST reviewed by author; no model/test/runtime invocation by author.
required_root_controls: Review script independently before relying on its result.
Run actual saved artifacts; preserve raw audit result and separate semantic_proof_missing list.

On in-memory/copy fixtures, independently verify that bad/missing final hash, stale num_heads target, duplicate decision, missing decision, wrong reader and default relabelled checkpoint each fail. Do not mutate actual captured files.
limitations: This verifies persisted record association under the original capture bracket; it does not reauthenticate live reader authority or prove mechanism semantics.
Llama only. Registered diffusion defaults, arbitrary aliases/normalization, other models and other event targets require separate contracts.
No blessing, output-delta acceptance, matrix acceptance or S9-A completion follows from PASS.
